title: Preserve accepted source slow-warning diagnostics when a later envelope check refuses
outcome: Known bounded slow-operation warnings remain observable when a status-0 source response fails later envelope, identity or root validation, while the response remains unavailable.
acceptance: A status-0 source response with accepted warning stderr and an invalid envelope, source identity or root remains unavailable and retains the accepted diagnostic.
Unsupported stderr is still refused without echoing its payload, and successful source identity semantics remain unchanged.
A behavioral regression distinguishes retained diagnostics on a later refusal from the successful-response path.
